{{Icon|Arts Susceptibility icon|text=false|nolink=true}} [[Arts Susceptibility]] is a type of debuff inflicted to enemies in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

When enemies are inflicted with '''Arts Susceptibility''', they temporarily take more {{Color|Arts DMG|7}}. The number represents the degree of increase.

An enemy that is considered '''Arts Susceptible''' is also considered Susceptible to all Arts Elements. For example, while {{Icon|Avywenna icon|[[Avywenna]]'s}} {{Color|Carrot and Sharp Stick|7}} only explicitly states that it is triggered from enemies that are {{G|Electric Susceptibility|Electric Susceptible}}, applying Arts Susceptibility to the target also triggers this Potential.

Multiple sources of Arts Susceptibility, as well as Susceptibility specific to only Arts [[Element]]s such as {{G|Heat Susceptibility}} stack <u>additively</u> to form the '''Susceptibility Multiplier''' for that DMG instance. The resulting Susceptibility Multiplier then stacks <u>multiplicatively</u> with other damage multipliers to get the final value. For more information on calculating damage, see [[Damage calculation]].
